name: process_refund
description: Issue a refund against an order. The order must already be cancelled or returned. Omitting amount refunds the whole outstanding balance; supply a value for a partial refund, and note that partial refunds are the usual case because shipping is not normally returned. Where the customer disputes the amount, issue the partial figure they name and let the balance stand.

error_returns.when: No order exists with the given order_id.
method is not original_payment or store_credit, amount is not positive, or amount is more than the balance still refundable.
The order is not cancelled or returned, or has already been refunded in full.
